第538章 仙宫黎清月收徒（第1页）
（第22页）如果事情到这里，那么凤灵儿也没什么可以担心的了，她虽然惊艳，但这仙界之上，超然势力无数，古老底蕴道统，各方林立。
其中，比她身份尊高，实力强大的女子有很多，如果那位大长老与仙宫不同意，那位少主也没有办法。
可偏偏，那仙宫之中，有人动用仙宫推演之术，算到她身上富有大气运！
若能够与仙宫结合，将有希望助那人突破仙帝……于是，仙宫当即便动了心思，有意促成这桩婚事。
正因为如此，凤灵儿这才离开三十三天，前去那禁地之外的神山之地历练，她想要突破境界，变得更强！
以此，来让凤族对自己更加看重，拒绝这桩婚事。
于是，便有了后面遇到孟尘以及黎清月的事情了。
黎清月闻言，美眸中闪过一丝柔和，并未拒绝。
既然她已将起源真解传授给了凤灵儿，便算是她的半个师尊。
更何况，对方乃是真凤血脉，而她如今融合了真凤祖血，得到了完整的真凤传承，自然有必要对其照拂。
凤灵儿闻言，自然无比激动，连忙对着黎清月跪拜，行师徒大礼。
黎清月虽然到了二道拓路境，但收徒还是第一次。
不过，前面有孟尘收徒苏清颜，她这里已经当了一次师娘，自然也适应了。
当下，她心念一动，身影缓缓消散在世外苍茫之中。
当她再次睁开双眼时，已然回归到了凤血仙池之中。
凤灵儿这里，自然也随着黎清月一同醒来。
黎清月归来，瞬间引起了整个第二层天真凤一族的剧烈震动！
所有感受到这股气息的真凤族人，无论身在何处，全都忍不住朝着凤族祖地的方向跪拜，宛若迎接先祖归来一般。
好在有凤七这个老祖的命令，他们才不敢随意靠近。
而凤七，本就跪伏在地上的身影，在近距离感受到黎清月身上的祖之本源后，更是虔诚到了极点。
他没有询问任何发生的经历，仅仅是这一道祖源气息，便让他彻底臣服了。
在他看来，黎清月，就是真凤真正的起源之祖！
不仅于此，当凤七的目光扫过凤灵儿时，内心同样掀起了惊涛骇浪。
因为在凤灵儿的身上，他同样看到了先前所没有的祖之本源！
如此惊艳的血脉觉醒，即便是三十三天之上，真凤族历代的天骄之子，也从未出现过啊！
如此之短的时间，她竟然直接突破到了真仙巅峰，这简直太不可思议了！
距离仙王之境，也只差一步而已啊！
要知道，如今这仙界之中，年轻一代之中，哪怕是绝世妖孽，最强者也不过是真仙之境，还没有一位少年仙王出世！
对于凤灵儿身上的婚事，他自然知道。
不过，仅凭他一个暮年的仙王，自然无法与真凤仙族之中的那些长老与始祖们抗衡。
更无法，将那仙宫给得罪了……他知道，凤灵儿如此历练，所为的是什么，无非是想要证明自身，不被族中掌权者去摆布命运罢了……眼下，她虽然没有踏入仙王，但已然进一步脱胎换骨了！

Chapter 538 Li Qingyue accepts a disciple in the Immortal Palace (page 1)
(Page 22) If things come to this, then Feng Ling'er has nothing to worry about. Although she is stunning, there are countless transcendent forces and ancient traditions in this fairy world.
Among them, there are many women with higher status and stronger strength than her. If the great elder and the Immortal Palace disagree, the young master has nothing to do.
However, someone in the Immortal Palace used the Immortal Palace deduction technique to calculate that she was rich in great luck!
If he could be combined with the Immortal Palace, it would be possible to help that person break through to become the Immortal Emperor... Therefore, the Immortal Palace immediately took the initiative to promote this marriage.
Because of this, Feng Ling'er left Thirty-Three Heavens and went to experience the sacred mountain outside the forbidden area. She wanted to break through the realm and become stronger!
In this way, the Feng clan will value themselves more and refuse this marriage.
So, there was the matter of meeting Meng Chen and Li Qingyue later.
When Li Qingyue heard this, a softness flashed in her beautiful eyes, but she did not refuse.
Since she has taught Feng Ling'er the true meaning of origin, she can be regarded as half of her master.
What's more, the other party is of the True Phoenix bloodline, and now that she has merged with the True Phoenix ancestral blood and obtained the complete True Phoenix inheritance, it is naturally necessary to take care of her.
When Feng Ling'er heard this, she was naturally extremely excited. She quickly knelt down to Li Qingyue and performed the master-disciple salute.
Although Li Qingyue has reached the Second Path Expansion Realm, this is the first time for him to accept a disciple.
However, there was Meng Chen's disciple Su Qingyan in front of her. She had already been a master's wife here, so she naturally got used to it.
At that moment, she had a thought in her mind, and her figure slowly disappeared into the vastness of the world.
When she opened her eyes again, she had returned to the Phoenix Blood Immortal Pond.
Feng Ling'er naturally woke up with Li Qingyue.
Li Qingyue's return instantly caused a violent shock in the entire second-level Tianzhenfeng clan!
All the Zhenfeng Clan members who felt this aura, no matter where they were, couldn't help but kneel down in the direction of the Feng Clan's ancestral land, as if welcoming their ancestors back.
Fortunately, with the order of the ancestor Feng Qi, they did not dare to approach at will.
And Feng Qi, who was already kneeling on the ground, became even more pious after feeling the ancestral origin of Li Qingyue at close range.
He didn't ask about any of his experiences. Just this ancestral breath made him completely surrender.
In his opinion, Li Qingyue is the true origin ancestor of Zhenfeng!
Not only that, when Feng Qi glanced at Feng Ling'er, there was also a turmoil in her heart.
Because in Feng Linger, he also saw the origin of his ancestors that he had never seen before!
Such an amazing bloodline awakening has never appeared before among the most talented sons of the True Phoenix Clan in the past thirty-three days!
In such a short period of time, she actually broke through to the peak of true immortality. This is simply incredible!
We are only one step away from the realm of the Immortal King!
You must know that in today's immortal world, among the younger generation, even the most powerful monsters are only in the realm of true immortals, and no young immortal king has yet been born!
He naturally knew about Feng Ling'er's marriage.
However, he alone, as an immortal king in his twilight years, was naturally unable to compete with the elders and ancestors of the True Phoenix Immortal Clan.
Even more helpless, he offended the Immortal Palace... He knew that Feng Ling'er's reason for practicing so much was to prove herself and not let her fate be dictated by the powerful people in the clan... At the moment, although she has not stepped into the Immortal King, she has further transformed!
